sloka: देवी सहायो भगवन् दिव्यम् वर्ष सहस्रकम् ।व्रतम् समाप्य वरदम् तुष्टाव मधुसूदनम् ॥१-२९-११॥
transliteration: devī sahāyo bhagavan divyam varṣa sahasrakam ।vratam samāpya varadam tuṣṭāva madhusūdanam ॥1-29-11॥

translations.english: "O Rama in the mean time revered Kasyapa resplendent like the god of fire radiating lustre with Aditi who had completed a thousand divine years of austerities pleased (with her penance) the conferer of boons, Lord Madhusudana" (Visnu) (And she said to Visnu):
translations.hindi: है राम ! यह लो प्रथन नामक वायव्यास्र, हयशिराञ्ज और क्रोश्चाख। मैं दो शक्तियाँ भी तुम्हें देता हूँ। में तुम्हें अब भयङ्कर कङ्काल नामक मुशल, कापाल और कङ्कण देता हूँ
